_doc: Generated by tools/build-realtime-projects.mjs from the game's public/assets/content/street-jobs.json (do not edit). jobs: street-building, street-upgrade and group hall projects (offer: the streets whose board offers it; a hall's claim currants and minutes); classes: "<phase class>/<divisor>" with the remake's amounts; restorations: a worn-out cultivation's phases (classes at divisor 1); drops: the performance drop tables; names: street tsid -> public name (the featured project's notices).
